description: This file defines the MarkerDrag handler for making map markers draggable in the Leaflet library, including methods for handling drag events, auto-panning, and class initialization.

classes.name: MarkerDrag
classes.description: Handler class for enabling draggable markers in Leaflet, managing drag events, auto-panning, and interaction hooks.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a marker instance.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Enables dragging by creating a Draggable instance and attaching event listeners.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Disables dragging and removes event listeners.

methods.name: moved
methods.description: Returns whether the marker has been moved during dragging.

methods.name: _adjustPan
methods.description: Automatically pans the map if the marker is near the edge during dragging.

methods.name: _onDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of dragging, firing relevant events.

methods.name: _onPreDrag
methods.description: Prepares auto-panning during dragging if enabled.

methods.name: _onDrag
methods.description: Updates marker position and fires move/drag events during dragging.

methods.name: _onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of dragging, firing relevant events and stopping auto-pan requests.
